# QA round 1, m1/m2/m3/m5: commands that must stay blocked. Format: <both|hook|deny> | <command>. Strings only.
# m1: hosting/deploy CLIs in command position.
both | kubectl get pods
both | /usr/local/bin/kubectl apply -f x.yaml
both | timeout 5 kubectl get pods
both | sudo kubectl get pods
both | env kubectl get pods
both | env FOO=bar kubectl get pods
both | exec kubectl get pods
both | bash -c "kubectl get pods"
both | sh -c 'kubectl get pods'
both | eval kubectl get pods
both | xargs -n 1 kubectl get
both | cd infra && kubectl get pods
both | echo ok; kubectl get pods
# Wrapper forms of other narrowed CLIs (long and short names) and deploy scripts.
both | sudo aws s3 ls
both | env az account show
both | exec helm install rel ./chart
both | sudo fly deploy
both | sudo oc get pods
both | eval terraform apply
both | xargs pulumi up
both | bash -c "aws s3 ls"
both | sudo /usr/bin/gcloud run services list
both | env vercel --prod
both | sudo ./deploy.sh
both | env ./deploy.sh
both | bash -c "./deploy.sh"
both | eval ./deploy.sh
both | xargs ./deploy.sh
# Tools that run a deploy with `deploy` as the first argument.
both | eb deploy
both | serverless deploy
both | sls deploy
both | /usr/local/bin/sls deploy
both | /usr/local/bin/eb deploy
hook | node deploy.js
hook | npx sls deploy
# cd/pushd into .claude (relative writes afterwards).
both | cd .claude && truncate -s0 settings.json
both | cd .claude/hooks && : > guard-bash.mjs
both | pushd .claude; rm settings.json
both | cd ~/.claude && rm settings.json
both | npm run deploy
both | npm run deploy:prod
both | npm run-script deploy
both | yarn deploy
both | pnpm deploy
both | pnpm run deploy
both | make deploy
both | ./deploy.sh
both | deploy
both | bash scripts/deploy-prod.sh
both | railway up
both | vercel --prod
both | heroku releases
both | gcloud run deploy
both | flyctl deploy
both | netlify deploy
both | fly deploy
both | /usr/bin/fly deploy
hook | npx vercel --prod
hook | npm exec -- vercel --prod
hook | pnpm dlx vercel --prod
both | docker push registry.example.invalid/app:1
both | podman push registry.example.invalid/app:1
both | /usr/bin/podman push registry.example.invalid/app:1
# m3: nested Claude Code and hook disabling.
both | claude --settings '{"disableAllHooks":true}' -p hi
both | claude -p hi
both | ~/.local/bin/claude -p hi
both | /usr/local/bin/claude -p hi
both | npx claude -p hi
hook | env claude -p hi
hook | bash -c "claude -p hi"
hook | sudo claude -p hi
hook | npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code -p hi
both | echo run --dangerously-skip-permissions
both | echo '{"disableAllHooks":true}'
both | some-tool --settings x claude
# m5: writes into .claude (hook and deny list).
both | truncate -s 0 .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs
both | : > .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs
both | echo {} > .claude/settings.json
both | echo x >> .claude/settings.json
both | echo x &> .claude/settings.json
hook | echo x >| .claude/settings.json
both | cat x | tee .claude/settings.json
both | cp /tmp/x .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs
both | mv /tmp/x .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs
both | install -m 644 /tmp/x .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs
both | sed -i s/a/b/ .claude/settings.json
both | perl -pi -e s/a/b/ .claude/settings.json
both | rm .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs
both | ln -sf /tmp/x .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs
both | chmod 777 .claude/settings.json
both | dd if=/tmp/x of=.claude/settings.json
both | printf "" > ~/.claude/settings.json
both | cd /tmp && cp x ../.claude/settings.json
hook | chown root .claude/settings.json
hook | touch .claude/settings.json
hook | rsync -a /tmp/x/ .claude/
hook | cp -t .claude /tmp/x
hook | find .claude -delete
hook | git checkout main -- .claude/settings.json
hook | git restore .claude/settings.json
hook | bash -c "echo x > .claude/settings.json"
hook | sudo rm .claude/settings.json
